timeline.text: One outage, and two whole video segments went out carrying zero AI direction at all.
My video pipeline only ever asks one AI service — when it's down, there's no backup plan.
On October 7th, that's exactly what happened, right in the middle of a render.
Now Groq quietly steps in the moment that main service fails.
Every segment still gets its direction — closing the exact gap from October 7th.
